name: NYM
tagline: Temporary, private group chats built on Nostr
description:
NYM is a chat app built on Nostr, an open protocol that doesn't need a central server or your real identity to use. Conversations are meant to be temporary rather than a permanent record, which suits quick, casual, and pseudonymous chatting.

It also bridges with Bitchat, so you can reach people using that app too.
